# Toon Boom

> > Toon Boom provides professional 2D animation software including Harmony and Storyboard Pro, serving studios worldwide with industry-leading tools for animation production.

The site features interviews with animators and studios, technical tutorials on Harmony workflows including rigging and compositing, and insights into the global animation industry. Major studios like Mercury Filmworks, Flying Bark Productions, and Netflix productions rely on Toon Boom's software for their animation pipelines.

## Key Topics

- Toon Boom Harmony
- Harmony Premium
- 2D Animation
- Character Rigging
- Compositing
- Animation Workflow
- Production Pipeline
- Mercury Filmworks
- Storyboarding
- Animation Industry
- Netflix Animation
- Cutout Animation
- Portfolio Development
- Animation Career Advice
- Color Design

## Harmony Workflow & Technical Tutorials

- [Making of The Duke's Game / Part 2: Rigging, Animation, Comp](https://www.toonboom.com/making-of-the-dukes-game-part-2-rigging-animation-comp): Mercury Filmworks tutorial on rigging and compositing in Harmony 22
- [Anja Shu on animating with watercolour effects and textures](https://www.toonboom.com/anja-shu-watercolour-effects): Anja Shu demonstrates watercolour animation techniques in Harmony 20
- [Renee Violet provides a rat's-eye-view of cutout animation](https://www.toonboom.com/renee-violet-provides-a-rats-eye-view-of-cutout-animation): Mercury Filmworks animator Renee Violet on cutout animation workflow
- [Mylène Thisdale on designing and compositing Graffitude](https://www.toonboom.com/mylene-thisdale-on-designing-and-compositing-graffitude): Mylène Thisdale on compositing student film Graffitude in Harmony
- [Tony Ross on teaching beginners Toon Boom Harmony Premium](https://www.toonboom.com/tony-ross-on-teaching-beginners-toon-boom-harmony-premium): Tony Ross discusses teaching Harmony Premium to beginners at Lynda.com

## Studio & Production Case Studies

- [Flying Bark Productions sur l'assemblage de la série animée LEGO Monkie Kid](https://www.toonboom.com/fr/flying-bark-productions-sur-lassemblage-de-la-serie-animee-lego-monkie-kid): Flying Bark Productions on LEGO Monkie Kid series production (French)
- [How animation took Doctor Who: The Macra Terror from missing to magic](https://www.toonboom.com/how-animation-took-doctor-who-the-macra-terror-from-missing-to-magic): Sun & Moon Studios revives BBC's lost Doctor Who episodes with Harmony
- [Studio Niloc on conjuring Where Rabbits Come From](https://www.toonboom.com/studio-niloc-on-conjuring-dou-viennent-les-lapins): Montreal's Studio Niloc on producing dystopian short film with Harmony
- [The Knights of The Light Table on Night Runner's neon-noir music video](https://www.toonboom.com/night-runner): Knights of Light Table discuss creating neon-noir Night Runner video
- [Ron Myrick on directing animation in How to Become a Tyrant](https://www.toonboom.com/ron-myrick-on-directing-animation-in-how-to-become-a-tyrant): Ron Myrick on directing documentary animation for Netflix series

## Animation Career & Industry Insights

- [Abigail Lee on #Feboardary and building community with story artists](https://www.toonboom.com/abigail-lee-on-feboardary-and-building-community-with-story-artists): Abigail Lee on Feboardary challenge and storyboard artist community
- [#ToonChat: Storyboarding roles & careers](https://www.toonboom.com/toonchat-august-30-2019): ToonChat Twitter discussion on storyboard careers with industry pros
- [Made in China: Why everybody is watching this Asian animation industry](https://www.toonboom.com/china-animation-industry-asian-market-report): Analysis of China's growing animation industry and streaming platforms
- [Where can animation families find resources and community in 2021?](https://www.toonboom.com/where-can-animation-families-find-resources-and-community-in-2021): Animation Guild's Family Committee on caregiver support and resources
